'''2001 Decipher World Championship Bastian Winkelhaus QMC Winkelhaus Style''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dt-19803">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19803 QMC Winkelhaus Style], DeckTech (Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus, 22 November 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19803/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19803/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016225700/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19803/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
* '''Event:''' [[2001 Decipher World Championship]]
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Published:''' 22 November 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''QMC Winkelhaus Style''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 QMC Winkelhaus LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' The deck i used at worlds.Yeah, Hunt down is a bad matchup, but it can beat everything else.

== Original post ==

'''QMC Winkelhaus Style'''
* '''Author:''' Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus
* '''Published:''' November 22, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' The deck i used at worlds.Yeah, Hunt down is a bad matchup, but it can beat everything else.

=== Strategy ===

Shields (10)

A Close Race

A Tragedy has Occured

Aim High

Battle Plan

Do, or do not

Dont do that again

He can go about his business

Ounee Ta

Wise Advice

Your Insight serves you well

The deck i used at FreedomCon to win it.

It lost Game 1 to Matt Bertas Huntdown, only to win the next 6 games.

Matt played Huntdown, which is a pretty bad matchup although certainly not an auto-loss.

Against everything else you definitely have a good shot.

No deck can win against everything these days.

Mad props to Fabien Jacques for convincing me to add Alternatives to fighting.

That card is huge

Laters

Bastian Winkelhaus
